title: Same-frame ESC + left-press while placing diverges from the old mouse path (drag never starts; release is swallowed)
location: app/input/mouse.odin:63-76,170-181,210 (mapping) + app/input/exec.odin:45-58 (executor Cancel) vs a4d6e9e:app/main.odin (old handle_input)
detail: ESC + left press in one frame while placement is armed: old code cancelled placement first, so the press started a draw drag (release committed a pipe or click-selected) and ran the popover/QoS UI checks. New code treats the press as a placement click (no Begin_Draw, no UI checks) and the executor's Cancel leaves press_swallowed set, so the release is suppressed. Line-by-line trace of both versions; input_parity_cancel only scripts ESC alone, so this corner is unpinned.
recommended_fix: In mouse_map, when esc_cancelled, decide the left-press branch on the post-cancel state (placing := -1, mirroring the old sequential order) and re-clear press_swallowed after the Cancel intent executes; add an ESC+press same-frame scenario to input_parity_cancel.

title: Four unused imports in the new app/input package (compile-clean today, dead baggage)
evidence:
app/input/exec.odin:18:import "core:fmt"  (no fmt. usage in the file)
app/input/touch.odin:17:import rl "vendor:raylib"  (no rl. usage in the file)
app/input/controller.odin:17:import rl "vendor:raylib"
app/input/controller.odin:18:import pp "../../core"  (neither rl. nor pp. used in the file)
detail: Verified `odin build app` and `odin check app` exit 0 on the pinned nightly (dev-2026-08-nightly:902106f) and an isolated /tmp probe confirms this nightly tolerates unused imports, so no build break today — but a stricter toolchain would fail, and the imports are dead baggage.
recommended_fix: Drop import "core:fmt" from exec.odin, import rl from touch.odin, and imports rl + pp from controller.odin.

title: key_map in poll.odin is orphaned — defined but never called
detail: key_map is never called — poll_mouse inlines every rl.KeyboardKey → Key translation and the harness scripts semantic keys directly. Dead code in the new package (pad_map, by contrast, is used by poll_controller).
recommended_fix: Delete key_map, or route poll_mouse's key polls through it so the mapping table is the single source of truth.
